nodes.label: Semantic Entropy for Hallucination Detection
nodes.author: Farquhar, Kossen, Kuhn, Gal
nodes.rationale: Method for detecting confabulations (arbitrary, incorrect LLM generations) by computing entropy over semantic meanings rather than token sequences; clusters answers by bidirectional entailment to distinguish paraphrases from genuine uncertainty.

nodes.label: Confabulation (LLM Failure Mode)
nodes.rationale: Subset of hallucinations where LLMs fluently make claims that are both wrong and arbitrary (sensitive to irrelevant details like random seed), distinct from consistent errors from training data or systematic reasoning failures.

nodes.label: Bidirectional Entailment Clustering
nodes.rationale: Operationalization of semantic equivalence using NLI tools; two sentences mean the same thing only if they entail each other bidirectionally, enabling clustering of paraphrases while distinguishing genuinely different meanings.

nodes.label: Discrete Semantic Entropy Variant
nodes.rationale: Approximation of semantic entropy for black-box LLMs without access to output probabilities; estimates P(Ci|x) from empirical distribution of sampled generations, enabling application to GPT-4 and similar closed models.

nodes.label: FactualBio Dataset
nodes.rationale: Biography-generation dataset of 21 individuals with 150 factual claims (45 incorrect), generated by GPT-4; enables evaluation of semantic entropy on paragraph-length generations with manual ground-truth labels.

nodes.label: Question-Answering Benchmarks
nodes.rationale: Five datasets for sentence-length evaluation: TriviaQA (trivia), SQuAD 1.1 (reading comprehension), BioASQ (life sciences), NQ-Open (Google Search queries), SVAMP (math word problems); context-free evaluation with 400 train/test examples each.

nodes.label: Semantic Entropy Performance Results
nodes.rationale: Averaged across 30 task-model combinations, semantic entropy achieves AUROC 0.790 (vs naive entropy 0.691, P(True) 0.698, embedding regression 0.687); outperforms baselines consistently across LLaMA, Falcon, Mistral families and model sizes.
